svg.title: Tumor immune microenvironment
svg.desc: Three-panel schematic of hypoxia, immune remodeling, and PD-1 checkpoint blockade.

g.inkscape:label: Figure title and page
g.text: Hypoxia, macrophage remodeling, and PD-1 checkpoint blockade
Conceptual schematic · Cell sizes and molecular shapes are illustrative.

g.inkscape:label: A Hypoxic tumor core
g.text: Niche signals can support myeloid recruitment
and survival, depending on tumor context.

g.inkscape:label: B Immune remodeling
g.text: TAM-mediated suppression can involve multiple pathways.

g.inkscape:label: C PD-1 checkpoint blockade
g.text: The antibody binds PD-1 on the CD8⁺ T cell.
